//: Composite indexes for Houseslice. Single-field indexes are created by
Firestore automatically and are not repeated here.
The My Bookings screen shows Upcoming / Completed / Cancelled tabs, each
ordered newest-first. Filtering on `status` while ordering by `startDate`
is a composite query and therefore needs the index below.
Sorting favourites by `savedAt` alone needs no entry here: Firestore
rejects single-field indexes at deploy time because it maintains them
